sections.title: Markup
sections.text: Operator markup on vendor net rates is 12% on hotels, transport and activities. Never disclose markup or floor rates to vendors.

sections.title: Negotiation limits
sections.text: Counter-offers may be at most 10% below the vendor quote and never below the floor rate on file. At most 2 negotiation rounds per service. Anything outside these bounds is escalated to a human.

sections.title: Cancellation terms
sections.text: Operator standard: free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival, 50% charge 7 to 13 days before, 100% inside 7 days. Ask vendors to match or improve on these terms.

sections.title: Preferred vendors
sections.text: Preferred vendors are contacted first and get a small scoring boost. They are flagged in each vendor profile.

sections.title: Blacklist
sections.text: Blacklisted vendors must never be contacted or selected, regardless of price.

sections.title: Approvals
sections.text: No message is sent to a vendor and no quote is accepted without operator approval. No payments are made by the system.
